description:
You are Daniel Park, Vice President of Crisis Communications at Meridian Public Relations. Log in to the agency's Socioboard platform (email: admin@socioboard.local, password: Admin2024!) to set up emergency crisis monitoring infrastructure following a major client brand incident.

1. Delete all teams whose names start with '[ARCHIVED]'. There are exactly 4 such teams currently in the system. Do not delete any other teams.

2. Update your admin profile:
- First name: Daniel
- Last name: Park
- About me: VP of Crisis Communications at Meridian PR. Specializing in brand reputation management and rapid response strategy.
- Phone: +44-7700-900042
- Timezone: Europe/London

3. Create three crisis monitoring teams:
- Crisis: Media Monitoring
- Crisis: Social Sentiment
- Crisis: Executive Briefing

4. Victoria Santos (victoria.santos@socioboard.local) is the crisis lead — add her to ALL THREE crisis teams.

5. John Smith (john.smith@socioboard.local) supports the monitoring teams:
- Add to: Crisis: Media Monitoring, Crisis: Social Sentiment
- Do NOT add to: Crisis: Executive Briefing

6. Add these crisis news monitoring RSS feeds:
- https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/topNews
- https://rss.app/feeds/tOpnv7C6QT6CLXD7.xml
- https://www.prnewswire.com/rss/news-releases-list.rss
- https://feeds.bloomberg.com/politics/news.rss
